description: Delete a credit bundle and the balance left in it: pass credit_id. It cannot be undone by another tool, so check it with get_credit first. Needs a claimed Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

credit_id.description: The credit bundle: its id, as list_credits shows it.

name: delete_credit
